question: The most popular combination of short cut keys to paste some copied content in most of the MS office applications is :
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + v**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Ctrl + v** is the shortcut key combination used to paste content in most MS Office applications.
 
• It is one of the most commonly used keyboard shortcuts for text editing across various software platforms.&
